completed.scene: Shared Caribbean island life in Belize and Honduras: distant sea kayaker passing a tiny uninhabited green cay with a few palms and coral shallows, viewpoint from a sandy shoreline with a driftwood branch foreground, clear morning.

completed.scene: Belize and Panama Caribbean mangroves: a long narrow sunlit water channel among dense mangrove islands, oblique aerial view with green forest reflected in still blue water, one distant white egret in flight, calm late morning.
